title: Nourishing Shaggy Mexican Chicken Mole Poblano
description: A citrusy and flavorful Mexican dish featuring chicken in a rich mole poblano sauce, wrapped in a flaky crust, this recipe is a show-stopper for any occasion, with an emphasis on ayurvedic-sattvic friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine ancho chili powder, orange juice, coconut oil, and dark chocolate chips, blending until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the chicken breasts and the mole poblano sauce, coating the chicken evenly.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the almond flour to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the chicken breasts in the center of the almond flour rectangle, leaving a 1 inch border around the chicken.
Brush the edges of the almond flour with a little water, then fold the dough over the chicken, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the chicken en croute on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and brush the top with a little coconut oil.
Sprinkle the pumpkin seeds and sea salt over the top of the chicken en croute.
Bake the chicken en croute in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
